name: Card
description: Surface that groups related content. Flat at rest with an inset top highlight; optional lift and pointer-following spotlight.
whenToUse: Grouping a unit of content: a project, a person, a plan, a stat.
Clickable tiles in a grid (add interactive).
whenNotToUse: Page sections — use plain layout, not a card around everything.

classes.ayy-card--interactive: Lifts on hover. Use when the whole card is clickable.
classes.ayy-card--spotlight: Pointer-following glow + lit border. Colour via the --ayy-spot custom property.
classes.ayy-card__title: Heading. Use an h2–h4 that fits your outline.
classes.ayy-card__footer: Actions row, pinned to the bottom.

js: cardClass({ interactive?, spotlight?, className? }) → string; trackSpotlight(pointerEvent) sets --ayy-mx/--ayy-my

react.import: import { Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardContent, CardFooter } from "ayywi/react";

props.spotlight: boolean — tracks the pointer for you
props.spotColor: CSS colour for the spotlight, e.g. "var(--ayy-accent-product)"

a11y: If the whole card is a link, put the <a> on the title and stretch it (::after inset:0), don't wrap the card in <a>.
Spotlight layers are pseudo-elements, invisible to assistive tech.
do: Use accent tokens (--ayy-accent-*) as spotColor to tie a card to a category.
Keep one level of cards; use hairline dividers inside.
dont: Don't set background colours on cards; the surface token keeps both themes correct.
Don't use spotlight on dense lists — it's for showcase grids.
